summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence work. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is limited to official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy artifacts; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Site-specific decisions: retain complicated.work parked because the site is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked because DNS reachability fails and compliance status is unknown. Next evidence actions are, respectively, remediate and recheck the banner/consent controls, and restore DNS reachability followed by a complete compliance checklist. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth elsewhere.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required; current evidence establishes access documentation but not rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliates or advertising. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending the actual data-flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor, notification-consent, and unsubscribe evidence. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and data-request evidence.

Compliance, data quality, analytics, site, SEO, revenue, and launch evidence support no fleet-wide legal clearance. Analytics source gaps and GSC permission errors must remain unknown or yellow rather than treated as zero; revenue must remain aggregate and unattributed; SEO and growth opportunities may remain deferred without blocking ordinary reversible work unless a site-specific compliance, disclosure, provenance, claims, platform-policy, copyright/trademark, or age-sensitive issue is evidenced.
